4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.

10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D free-roam racing game with a garage and selectable cars.
- The user emphasized: “no NEON.”

## Requirements
- Free-roam driving, garage car selection, and Low/Medium/High/Ultra graphics settings.
- Avoid neon visuals.

## Decisions
- Created a self-contained Three.js country-road driving game with a muted, natural palette, four vehicles, quality settings, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial game UI and styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Added Three.js scene, road, valley scenery, vehicles, garage selection, settings, and driving logic in `game.js`.
- Installed Chromium and started a local HTTP server for browser verification.
- Fixed the initial module issue by adding the Three.js import at the start of `game.js`.

### Active
- Finish `game.js`: its current version ends after `updateDriving`; the camera update and render loop have not yet been added.
- Verify the game in-browser, check console errors, capture a screenshot, and fix any issues.

### Blocked
- Browser verification is incomplete because the game currently has no render loop.

## Next Move
1. Add `updateCamera`, animation/render loop, and resize handler to `game.js`.
2. Run `node --check game.js`, reload `http://localhost:3002`, and inspect console output.
3. Test garage, car switching, driving, graphics quality, settings, and touch controls; save and inspect a current screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Main game implementation; currently incomplete at `updateDriving`.
- `index.html`: Garage, HUD, settings, and touch-control markup.
- `style.css`: UI styling and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- Browser was opened at `http://localhost:3002`; initial error was `ReferenceError: THREE is not defined`, then `game.js` was rewritten to begin with the module import.
- Files have not been committed.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D free-roam racing game with a garage and selectable cars.

## Requirements
- Include free-roam driving, garage car selection, and Low/Medium/High/Ultra graphics settings.
- Avoid neon visuals.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained Three.js country-road driving game with a muted, natural palette, four vehicles, quality settings, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added game UI, styling, Three.js scene, scenery, vehicles, garage selection, settings, driving logic, camera updates, and animation/render loop.
- Fixed a CSS syntax error that prevented most UI styles from loading.
- Fixed road strip triangle winding so surfaces face upward.
- Verified `node --check game.js` and browser loading without reported JavaScript exceptions.
- Browser-tested car selection, graphics quality selection, and driving; confirmed speed and HUD update.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. (none)

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, vehicles, controls, settings, camera, and render loop.
- `index.html`: Garage, HUD, settings, and touch-control markup.
- `style.css`: UI styling and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Browser verification screenshot saved to `/tmp/opencode/countryline-1440.png`.
- The local HTTP server on port `3002` was already running; an attempted second server failed because the port was in use.
